sections.title: I. Read the following announcement and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct option
sections.introHtml: Living in a "concrete jungle" like Hong Kong or New York can be both exciting and stressful. These cities are packed (1) _____ high buildings and modern public amenities like shopping malls and cinemas. However, the density of the population often leads to serious (2) _____ congestion. The more crowded the city gets, the more (3) _____ the streets become. Drivers often don't obey traffic rules, which indirectly causes many accidents. Moreover, the dust and dirt from construction sites can badly affect people's health. For example, many residents suffer from (4) _____ eyes and runny noses when they go outside. To improve the situation, the local government should invest more in green spaces and trees. (5) _____ , they need to encourage people to cut down on using private cars. If these problems are solved, city life will be much more pleasant. People will be able to enjoy the benefits of a modern city without worrying too much about their health and safety.

sections.title: II. Read the following passage and choose the best option to answer the questions below
sections.introHtml:
Portion control is also important when you're trying to lose weight. One problem many overweight teens have is that they underestimate how much they really eat. So, stop super-sizing, and learn what a healthy portion looks like. It may also help to eat more suitably. Six small meals per day appears to be one of the best approaches to eating, especially when you're trying to lose weight. Just remember these mini meals need to be small. If you feel you are overweight, talk to your primary health care provider or a registered dietitian. There are plenty of medically supervised diets that work well for teens who need to lose more than 10 pounds. Just be sure to include exercise, or you'll find that the weight comes back as easily as it left you.

(Adapted from: https://www.webmd.com)
